T.cuda.sm90.Wgmma
  parameters
    n
        predicates:
          n % 8 == 0
          8 <= n <= 256
    form
        predicates:
          form in {Form.SS, Form.RS}
    a_major  form=SS  a_major in {Major.MN, Major.K} (default Major.MN)
             form=RS  Major.K
  operands
    C  shape=(64, n) dtype=f32 storage=rmem, held in 1 arrangement:
         Layout((8, 2, 4, 2, 4, c), (1, 8, 16, 64, 128, 512))
         predicates:
           8 * c == n
    A  form=SS  shape=(64, 16) dtype=bf16 storage=smem, held in 3 arrangements:
                  a_major=MN  ComposedLayout(Swizzle(a_swizzle, 4, 3), 0, Layout(((r, W), (2, 8)), ((l, 1), (s, W))))
                                predicates:
                                  r * W == 64
                                  l == 16 * W
                                  s == 8 * W
                  a_major=K   ComposedLayout(Swizzle(a_swizzle, 4, 3), 0, Layout(((8, 8), (r, W)), ((l, W), (s, 1))))
                                predicates:
                                  a_swizzle <= 1
                                  r * W == 16
                                  l == 16 * W
                                  s == 8 * W
                  a_major=K   ComposedLayout(Swizzle(a_swizzle, 4, 3), k0, Layout(((8, 8), 16), ((l, W), 1)))
                                predicates:
                                  a_swizzle >= 2
                                  l == 8 * W
                                  k0 % 16 == 0
                                  k0 >= 0
                                  k0 < W
                  predicates:
                    W == (8, 16, 32, 64)[a_swizzle]
       form=RS  shape=(64, 16) dtype=bf16 storage=rmem, held in 1 arrangement:
                  Layout((8, 2, 4, 2, 4, 2), (1, 8, 16, 64, 128, 512))
    B  shape=(16, n) dtype=bf16 storage=smem, held in 1 arrangement:
         ComposedLayout(Swizzle(b_swizzle, 4, 3), 0, Layout(((2, 8), (rb, Wb)), ((sb, Wb), (lb, 1))))
         predicates:
           Wb == (8, 16, 32, 64)[b_swizzle]
           rb * Wb == n
           lb == 16 * Wb
           sb == 8 * Wb
  attributes
    scope  Mesh(('thread',), ComposedLayout(None, p0, Layout(((4, 8, 4),), ((32, 4, 1),))))
             predicates:
               p0 % 128 == 0
               each top-level mode has no backward step
               each top-level mode reaches each of its own slots exactly once
